gloss: self-destructive; reckless despair; giving up on oneself

definitions.explanation: A state of having lost hope and acting recklessly without caring about consequences, often damaging oneself in the process.

examples.japanese: ⟦{失恋|しつれん}→失恋：04195_shitsuren⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧{自暴自棄|じぼうじき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: To become self-destructive after a broken heart.

examples.japanese: {自暴自棄|じぼうじき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{解決|かいけつ}→解決：00136_kaiketsu⟧⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Nothing is solved by giving in to despair.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{失|うしな}って→失う：01887_ushinau⟧{自暴自棄|じぼうじき}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: He lost his job and started acting recklessly out of despair.

notes:
FOUR-CHARACTER IDIOM (⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧):
{自暴|じぼう} (self-abandonment) + {自棄|じき} (giving up on oneself)

ETYMOLOGY:
- {自|じ}: self
- {暴|ぼう}: violence, recklessness
- {棄|き}: to abandon, to discard

COMMON PATTERNS:
Used as a na-adjective with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ or as a noun:
- {自暴自棄|じぼうじき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to become self-destructive)
- {自暴自棄|じぼうじき}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧ (self-destructive behavior)

USAGE:
Describes someone who has lost all hope and no longer cares about the consequences of their actions, often leading to harmful behavior.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦やけ→やけ：noentry⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become desperate/reckless
- ⟦{投|な}げやり→投げやり：12781_nageyari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become careless/indifferent
- ⟦{諦|あきら}める→諦める：01813_akirameru⟧: to give up
